summary: After the missing SWARM-PROTOCOL lease was activated for the health-validation-fence primary, control validation exposed a separate prerequisite: immutable REVIEW_RESULT event evt-20260811-072455-q9m4r2-authority-review-block.json carries direct structured review fields pr/headSha/verdict that current core.validate_event rejects. Do not rewrite immutable event history. Recovery requires backward-compatible typed event validation or a dedicated prerequisite lane before the health-fence fix can receive authoritative ownership proof.
evidence: Control push run 31469007847 job 93707966668 fails in hardened validate with unknown keys ['headSha', 'pr', 'verdict'] on evt-20260811-072455-q9m4r2-authority-review-block.json.
The failing event is a REVIEW_RESULT with a positive PR number, 40-hex head SHA, and REQUEST_CHANGES verdict; its core evidence/summary are otherwise valid.
tools/swarm/swarmctl.py validate_event currently permits only base event fields plus laneId/severity/evidence/toWorker/metadata and therefore cannot replay this immutable structured review event.
PR #298 lane write scope intentionally excludes tools/swarm/swarmctl.py, so the primary should not silently broaden production validator scope without scheduler-visible prerequisite handling.
